correctness.rationale: Neighbor-count formulas for fort vertices hold at all indices; full case split |P|>=3,=2,=1,=0 with apex indicator exhausts forts. Fort-stalling equivalence yields every forcing set. Disjoint choices prove the full polynomial. The exchange graph has exhaustive three-type classification; Johnson graph connectivity proves global connectedness. Source-code enumeration from graph adjacency fully checks n=4..8; two distinct forcing engines cross-check n=4..6 and all minimal forts are exhaustively checked n=4..7. Infinite conclusion rests on proof.

broader_coverage.reasoning: General polynomial/reconfiguration definitions do not determine specific coefficients, fort types, degree strata or graph connectivity. Complete multipartite and fan or chain hypotheses fail: μ(K_n) contains an induced five-cycle a_i-a_j-b_i-w-b_j-a_i; n>=4 also gives a clique. The scalar zero-forcing number in earlier Mycielski studies cannot imply the full solution-set enumeration or the optimum exchange-graph structure.

originality.rationale: The most relevant inspected primary literature establishes the general polynomial, forcing, and reconfiguration frameworks but not the combined Mycielskian complete-family theorem. Nearby research-index records concern graph families excluded by structural distinctions including an induced C5. The inaccessible 2021 Rameh work presents a real scalar-overlap risk, which is disclosed; complete polynomial, fort types and exchange strata not found in available evidence. Best-knowledge originality, not global uniqueness certification.
residual_risks: The complete 2021 Mycielski-zero-forcing study at sid.ir/paper/953698/en was inaccessible; it might cover the scalar value or more, though its indexed description did not establish the stronger full result.
Equivalent results in inaccessible or unindexed sources may exist; published-finding corpus and web search are not global novelty proofs.

value.rationale: For an infinite standard graph family, the five exact minimal-fort forms are a finite obstruction classification; they recover every permissible forcing set, all size counts, all minimum configurations, and an exact connected nonregular optimum exchange graph with three degrees. This answers naturally motivated counting and reconfiguration questions not resolved by the numerical minimum alone.
